title: Content-doc frontmatter
description: Single source of the frontmatter rules for content docs (plan 0015). Read by .github/scripts/lib/doc_frontmatter.py and doc_status.py; CONTRIBUTING §1 links here. Each key's x-rdf names the RDF term it means, or null where no standard term fits.

purpose.description: One sentence on one line saying what the doc covers; detail goes in the body or on the **Details:** line.

updated.description: Date of the last content edit; metadata-only edits don't change it.

validated_links_on.description: Date the doc's URLs were last checked.

status.description: Where the doc's subject stands for us: Technology Radar rings (adopt, trial, assess, hold) plus research, reference and archived; see CONTRIBUTING §2. The mapping to schema:creativeWorkStatus is approximate: the rings assess the subject, not the doc's own lifecycle.

source.description: The one primary URL; other sources go in the Sources section.

platform_scope.description: Optional. Agent harnesses and hosts the doc's subject works with or runs on, as an inline list of slugs from this enum (synonyms merged: codex covers Codex CLI; github-copilot covers Copilot CLI). Editors, surfaces, operating systems, chat channels, clouds, model providers and protocols go on the **Details:** line instead. Not used for cc-native docs (the folder already says claude-code). Maps only approximately to dcterms:subject: it describes the subject tool's reach, not the doc's topic.

x-removed.sources: sources belong in the Sources section at the end
x-removed.release: release status goes on the **Details:** line (CONTRIBUTING §2)
x-removed.version: the version goes on the **Details:** line
x-removed.license: the licence goes on the **Details:** line
x-removed.category: the filename suffix (-landscape, -analysis, -reference, …) already says it

plan.description: Frontmatter of docs/plans/ files (not checked by check_frontmatter).
